name: Main Menu Notebook
description:
Sticky notes for your Main Menu and Pause Menu!

How to Use:
• Ctrl + Left-Click: Create a new note
• Click note body: Type text directly in the note (game keybinds suppressed while typing)
• Header: Drag to move note anywhere on screen
• [+] Button: Stack notes with multiple tabs
• Tab Numbers: Left-click to switch tabs, Right-click to close a tab
• ● Button: Cycle color palette for the active tab
• – Button: Fold / unfold note
• ⇲ Handle: Drag bottom-right corner to resize
• ✕ Button: Delete note

Notes persist automatically per menu (main_menu_notes.json & pause_menu_notes.json). To regenerate default welcome notes, delete the respective config file.
